articles.title: Mint: Fresh Sheet
articles.summary: Soft mint green with a regular brick-block weave, satin and slightly sparkly, like uncut printed sheets. Reads as a muted green with vertical column banding and a rough woven look; light and dark patches make it look mottled.
articles.what: Thirty-two notes to a sheet, uncut, before the guillotine ever touches them. Up close: Tall columns of stacked horizontal strips in sage and mint green, from pale seafoam highlights to dark forest green, separated by dark vertical gaps. Each strip is hatched with fine diagonal tick marks, so it looks like a pile of printed paper sheets. Columns are about 40 px wide. From a distance: Reads as a muted green with vertical column banding and a rough woven look; light and dark patches make it look mottled. Measured spec (average): metal 71, roughness 97, coat 95. Shine: satin. Metal: low. It brings its own colours.

articles.summary: Dull antique gold/brass with fine flake, warm and aged rather than bright yellow. A flat dull antique-gold, slightly greenish like old brass or khaki, with a fine sandy shimmer; nothing bright or showy.
articles.what: Two microns of gold over brass, and it wears through exactly where a thumb would rest. Up close: Very fine olive-gold grain, tiny soft squares of khaki, mustard and brown with scattered brighter yellow glints, evenly spread. It reads as mossy brass, with no relief, direction or bold features. From a distance: A flat dull antique-gold, slightly greenish like old brass or khaki, with a fine sandy shimmer; nothing bright or showy. Measured spec (average): metal 102, roughness 139, coat 123. Shine: semi-matte. Metal: medium. It brings its own colours.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: black or dark green stripes and number panels: warm gold on dark reads rich; simple badges or pinstripes: the grain is even so they sit calmly
Patterns to avoid: flake, carbon or noise patterns: they bury the micro sparkle; other gold finishes: same hue twice looks cheap
Spec overlays that work: gloss clearcoat to brighten the gold; a brushed or sheen spec for a luxe tone

articles.title: Asset: Platinum Ingot
articles.summary: Bright silver-white fine flake with a distinct horizontal brick-like banding, high gloss metal. Reads as a bright silver-white brick or tile wall; the bars blur to a horizontal-banded light grey with dark dashes, loud and busy.
articles.what: Denser than gold, rarer than gold, and it does not care what you think of it. Up close: Stacked running-bond bricks, each a long bar about 50 to 80 px by 12 px, in many shades of white, silver and mid grey, with a fine grainy edge. Small dark square notches sit at the joints between bars, and the courses lean very slightly diagonal. From a distance: Reads as a bright silver-white brick or tile wall; the bars blur to a horizontal-banded light grey with dark dashes, loud and busy. Measured spec (average): metal 167, roughness 87, coat 70. Shine: satin. Metal: high. It brings its own colours.

articles.title: Counterfeit: Rescreened
articles.summary: Flat grey with a fine diagonal screen-mesh weave, like a photocopied halftone printed onto dull metal. Reads as a mid warm-grey with a fine grainy fabric shimmer and soft dark mottling; neutral and quiet, like pewter or scanned paper.
articles.what: Photographed and reprinted. The scanner's grid beat against the engraving and left its confession. Up close: Warm grey surface of fine wavy diagonal ridges, 2-3 px apart, tilting up-right, that wobble and break into short wavy tick marks, with darker cloudy patches 30-60 px behind them. It looks like woven linen or a moire print, not a dot grid. From a distance: Reads as a mid warm-grey with a fine grainy fabric shimmer and soft dark mottling; neutral and quiet, like pewter or scanned paper. Measured spec (average): metal 38, roughness 120, coat 115. Shine: semi-matte. Metal: low. It brings its own colours.
